title: Genie Code scheduled tasks will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Genie Code scheduled tasks will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled in October 2026.

You can schedule Genie Code to run a prompt on a recurring schedule. Each run executes your prompt as a full Genie Code session and produces a continuable Genie chat with the results, so you can turn recurring analysis and other work into an unattended background task.

See [Genie Code scheduled tasks](/aws/en/genie-code/scheduled-tasks).
